name: Interim Reply Prompt (simulations WITHOUT working memory)
description: Writes the interim — a short, non-committal holding line — for simulations that do NOT use client working memory. While the learner is still speaking on a long turn, a fast model reads the partial transcript and drafts one line; the agent plays it after the thinking filler if it fits the wait, and the real reply carries on from its words. Simulations WITH working memory never use this prompt: their interim is written by the 'interim' field of the Client Working Memory Updater prompt. Runs only when the simulation has interimReplyEnabled on. Variables: {scenario_context}, {language_label}, {language_code}.
